notes.title: Store Page for the Sequel to "Revenant" is Now Live!
notes.notes: [p]Hello fans! This is MAYFLY.[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce that the Steam store page for our upcoming title, "Project Revenant"—the official sequel to "Revenant"—is now live![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850590/Project_Revenant/" style="button"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850590/Project_Revenant/[/url][/p][p]Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p]"Project Revenant" is a remake-style sequel that builds upon the original game and features the following core elements:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Precision Aiming[/p][/*][/list][p]The iconic cursor-based aiming system from the "Revenant" series returns, sharper than ever.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/e61a9094b883e45a15a6ab5809ab840463466ec9.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Tactical Freedom[/p][/*][/list][p]Utilize map mechanics and unique skills to dominate the battlefield in your own style.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/f1102bc967dc53a042897040300875f17f716692.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Distinctive Bosses[/p][/*][/list][p]Face off against uniquely designed RPG-style bosses and enjoy the thrill of strategizing your way through each battle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/2acfdaa6116ecdcb75c69ae37ffdb8c530cb6113.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Cinematic Cutscenes[/p][/*][/list][p]Follow government agent "Beta" as she carries out her missions, brought to life through cinematic cutscenes and immersive direction.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/e8004f242e61464a725198f28649406985947336.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced Action[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve significantly increased the combat tempo compared to the original "Revenant," offering fast-paced, John Wick-style action like never before.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/8a92030556629578323762401ca01a12ada68736.gif"][/img][/p][p]And that's just the beginning—there’s so much more we can’t wait to share with you soon! Expect more frequent updates moving forward.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]"No Compromise in Development. A New Era of Action." [/p][p]This has been MAYFLY. We'll see you again with more exciting news.[/p]

notes.title: Revenant – Gamepad Support Announcement!
notes.notes:
To fully experience Revenant's core mechanic—"Precision Aiming"—on console, haptic feedback is essential. PlayStation's DualSense controller, in particular, offers advanced technology to make this possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/db675a424fc826589548d53ee65af514e8414025.gif[/img]

Beyond just the "Adaptive Triggers," intuitive "Precision Aiming" using gyro-sensor-based aim assistance is vital. (Splatoon fans know exactly what we're talking about!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800877/988fa8c573940d3ef1f3f03834bc0e93d867b80b.gif[/img]

The current version of Revenant available for free on Steam is undergoing significant changes. We're moving away from slower pacing and stealth mechanics, returning instead to our original inspiration—fast-paced, action-packed gameplay reminiscent of the movie "John Wick."

Expect innovative mechanics and systems carefully crafted through thousands of hours of development and fine-tuning. Revenant isn't just about shooting; it's about delivering an exceptional gaming experience.

See you soon, and thank you for your support!

"Death is just a step away—but victory lies within your next shot."
